changelog: New application ids: es.gestal.supertube (phones and tablets) and es.gestal.supertube.tv (Android TV). They are installed as new apps, next to older versions.
The focused video fills the background (Netflix-like backdrop), with a SuperTube ambient image when there is none.

Settings › User interface › Lite mode (slow TVs): no background images, card previews, scrolling titles or seek thumbnails, and a smaller video buffer. The background image can also be turned off on its own.
SuperTube name, icons, launcher banner and home screen channel logo.
Updates from the SuperTube GitHub releases (Settings › About › Check for updates). The SmartTube voice-search bridge, donation links and Firebase crash reports are gone.
The phone app only downloads the phone APK from a release that also carries the TV ones.

Website in 6 languages (landing/, generated by tools/landing/gen_landing.py) with a playable TV demo, privacy policy and legal notice, and promotional images for social networks (promo/, tools/landing/promo.py).
